gameLocalization.note: Guide spelling variants are resolved against paired Canto VIII part 3 records: the long insect's death skill uses 庇護 rather than the guide's 介護; Shi Miyin uses シー・ミィイン rather than シー・ミィユン. Precious Jade's Cradle has distinct skill and status names; each follows its matching record. Phase thresholds remain approximate, and lethal-damage recovery retains its phase and surviving-ally requirements. Original guide conditions, numeric values, and uncertainty are retained.

name.text: Jia Mu / Muddled Heishou of the Corpse Palanquin

lead.text: A 6-phase endurance fight. Protect Hong Lu early; after the Distortion, handle the Precious Jade, Palanquin, and elders in that order. Once Happiness is active, use Hong Lu's clash wins to replenish resources and sustain healing.

listLead.text: A 6-phase endurance fight. Protect Hong Lu early; later, remove interference in the order jewel, palanquin, then remaining adds. After gaining Joy, use Hong Lu's Clash Wins to replenish resources and sustain healing.

statNote.text: The regular 8-33 encounter. Hong Lu is required; deploy 7 Sinners with 5 reserves. Offense/Defense entries show base values before Malattunement (+2), Supernatural, Strength, Chaos, and Spirits (+4), and other buffs. The Distorted body's 4759 HP is separate from the Torso's 4333 and Palanquin's 474 part HP. Listed phase-transition HP values differ: roughly 4100 / 2850–2900 / 1900–2000 / 700–720. Do not treat them as exact thresholds.

skillNote.text: Full skill names appear in the skill list; the walkthrough shortens the long names to the eye's powers attack or the insect's death attack. Conditional Unbreakable Coins are listed in effects, separately from fixed Unbreakable Coins. The Palanquin and Torso share a defense skill name but have different Unbreakable Coin listings.

priorities.0.text: Hong Lu's death causes defeat until Happiness is gained. Use faster Sinners to redirect attacks.

priorities.1.text: Destroy the Precious Jade before it explodes, extract the Palanquin, and reduce all 5 elders to 1 HP.

priorities.2.text: Redirect the eye's powers attack away from Hong Lu as main target, and secure resources for healing.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: Hong Lu dies early and the fight ends

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: He is not immortal from the start. Use faster Sinners or Bind to redirect dangerous attacks, and use SP/HP recovery early. Protect him until Happiness is gained.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: The Distorted form's HP will not decrease

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: The Precious Jade, Palanquin, and elders supply Shield. Focus whichever source is currently present. Delaying the Jade's destruction does not extend the action cycle; it only shortens the time available to damage the boss.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: Area attacks remain Unbreakable after destroying the Jade

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Last-ditch Struggle also makes the eye's powers attack Unbreakable when Hong Lu is its main target. Redirect it to someone else. While the Jade is alive, redirection alone does not stop the Unbreakable Coins; destroy the Jade first.

troubleshooting.3.symptom.text: The elders will not die, and the area attack wipes the team

troubleshooting.3.advice.text: Reducing them to 1 HP is enough. Leave elders with Imperfect Immortality and convert all 5 before the Offering. Even 1 remaining Sublime Immortality strengthens the finisher.

units.0.notes.0.text: Malattunement gives +2 base Offense/Defense Levels. Using different skills further raises Offense Level.

units.0.notes.1.text: At 693 HP, enters the next phase and ends the turn. Do not exhaust strong skills immediately after Staggering her.

units.1.name.text: Muddled Heishou of the Corpse Palanquin [混覺轀輬黑獸]

units.1.stagger.text: 0% (0) / Staggered by Palanquin extraction or 5 Imperfect Immortality

units.1.notes.0.text: From phase 2, Supernatural, Strength, Chaos, and Spirits gives +4 base Offense/Defense Levels. Do not confuse this with the part table's +8 Defense Level.

units.1.notes.1.text: Each slot takes 3 Attack Weight. The body can draw area attacks' targeting capacity away from adds; check actual secondary targets.

units.1.notes.2.text: Body HP determines phase transitions. Do not use Torso part HP as the threshold.

units.2.name.text: Muddled Heishou of the Corpse Palanquin · Palanquin

units.2.notes.0.text: Cannot be attacked until phase 3 begins. Becomes active in the Joy phase and supplies Shield and Torso buffs.

units.2.notes.1.text: Extract it at 0 HP to Stagger the Torso and inflict Fragile next turn. Some skills prevent Stagger until they are used.

units.3.notes.0.text: Created with 1 Explosive Amusement. Destroy it with the allies still able to act before it explodes.

units.3.notes.1.text: A Sinner defeating it grants resources, healing, and enemy debuffs. Hong Lu returns next turn.

units.4.notes.0.text: At 1 HP, Sublime Immortality becomes Imperfect Immortality. HP does not reach 0.

units.4.notes.1.text: Stop attacking at 1 HP and switch to elders that still have Sublime Immortality.

units.5.notes.0.text: At 1 HP, Sublime Immortality becomes Imperfect Immortality. HP does not reach 0.

units.5.notes.1.text: Prioritize this elder because its on-use effects strengthen Mu's attacks.

units.6.notes.0.text: At 1 HP, Sublime Immortality becomes Imperfect Immortality. HP does not reach 0.

units.6.notes.1.text: Stop attacking at 1 HP and switch to elders that still have Sublime Immortality.

phases.0.title.text: Bring sustained healing and enough Speed to protect Hong Lu

phases.0.steps.0.text: Recommended Level 55; deploy 7 Sinners with 5 reserves. Hong Lu must deploy initially, and a borrowed Identity is available. Check healing E.G.O, required resource affinities, and reserve levels.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Lust, Gluttony, Pride, and Envy work well. Do not build solely around affinities; prepare strong clashes, area attacks, and HP/SP recovery.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Check support combinations too. With Spiderweb Ryōshū and Ring Hong Lu, the allied effect associated with Ryōshū's Evade can endanger Hong Lu. Check its conditions before using both during the opening, when his protection is not yet active.

phases.1.title.text: Redirect attacks from Hong Lu and reduce Mu to 693 HP

phases.1.steps.0.text: The enemy focuses Hong Lu. Use faster Sinners to redirect dangerous attacks, with Bind and healing to protect him. His death causes defeat.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Si and Hun are area attacks; You has 3 Unbreakable Coins. Heal because hits remain after clash wins. Completed Heixian Bolus - You [酉] - Defense is a Clashable Guard and cannot be Offset by defense skills.

phases.1.steps.2.text: At 693 HP, the phase changes and the turn ends. This is shortly after the 762 Stagger threshold; avoid committing excessive powerful skills and save damage for the next Precious Jade.

phases.2.title.text: Destroy the Jade quickly and bring Hong Lu back

phases.2.steps.0.text: For ordinary Hong Lu Identities, winning the first Precious Jade's Cradle [寶玉搖籃] does not prevent imprisonment. His Lord Identity's exclusive support can prevent it from this stage. The old Assist Defense bug that skipped imprisonment has been fixed; do not rely on it.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Focus Lust/Gluttony damage on the 171-HP Jade. Destroy it on its first action turn if possible, or its second at the latest. Its turn 3 explosion heavily buffs Mu.

phases.2.steps.2.text: While the Jade is alive, 200 Shield every turn makes the boss hard to damage. Defeating it grants healing, 3 of every E.G.O resource, and enemy debuffs; Hong Lu returns next turn. The 5-turn cycle does not extend based on when it is destroyed, so earlier destruction creates more time to attack the boss.

phases.2.steps.3.text: The next phase begins around 4100 body HP. Maintain necessary clashes against area attacks and do not delay destroying the Jade.

phases.3.title.text: Have Hong Lu beat Precious Jade's Cradle to replenish resources

phases.3.steps.0.text: With Happiness, Hong Lu recovers 50% HP upon lethal damage while at least 1 other ally is alive. Clash wins against Mu grant a total of 3 resources of the least-owned affinities. Keep other allies alive too.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Hong Lu winning against Precious Jade's Cradle [寶玉搖籃] prevents imprisonment. Happiness also prevents it unconditionally once in this phase; do not treat that as repeatable protection.

phases.3.steps.2.text: With Last-ditch Struggle, the eye's powers attack becomes Unbreakable when Hong Lu is main target too. Redirect this one to another Sinner; use other skills for Hong Lu's resource generation.

phases.3.steps.3.text: The next phase begins around 2850–2900 body HP. The part table and walkthrough give different thresholds; check the actual phase display.

phases.4.title.text: Destroy the Palanquin to stop Shield and buffs

phases.4.steps.0.text: The Palanquin becomes active, supplying the body and Torso with Shield equal to 10% maximum HP and buffs for next turn. Focus and extract the 474-HP Palanquin rather than attacking only the Torso.

phases.4.steps.1.text: Be honored to be in audience of such a great man can be clashed regardless of Speed. Win to halve its damage and limit area damage; this does not cancel the on-use Torso buffs.

phases.4.steps.2.text: The insect's death attack becomes Unbreakable below 50% body HP. Prepare a reliable clash winner and healing. Exploit Torso Stagger and Fragile after extracting the Palanquin, then progress around 1900–2000 HP.

phases.5.steps.0.text: O Xianren...! creates 5 elders next turn and ends the turn after attacking. The summon is a Combat Start effect and cannot be stopped by a clash win.

phases.5.steps.1.text: Aim to reduce everyone to 1 HP within about 3 turns after spawning. Prioritize Earthly Elders, which provide attack buffs; stop spending actions on elders already at 1 HP. The body's slot weight of 3 can absorb area targeting capacity; check actual secondary targets.

phases.5.steps.2.text: If all 5 have Imperfect Immortality, the Offering grants allies 200 Shield, and Mu can be Staggered after absorbing 5 Imperfect Immortality. Even 1 remaining Sublime Immortality produces dangerous buffs.

phases.5.steps.3.text: Reducing elders to 1 HP grants SP and resources. Use these for healing and the remaining elders; enter the final phase around 700–720 body HP.

phases.6.title.text: Prepare for the opening 2 area attacks and finish the fight

phases.6.steps.0.text: Hong Lu gains +5 Final Power, resource generation, and recovery from lethal damage while another ally survives. Heal to avoid losing every other Sinner.

phases.6.steps.1.text: The opening 2 insect's death attacks are Unbreakable with 3 Attack Weight. A clash win halves damage and prevents Stagger from the skill, but does not prevent Bleed or Rupture damage.

phases.6.steps.2.text: Without elders, the Offering grants 200 Shield. Keep winning strong clashes and damaging the boss; this phase ends by reducing body HP to 0.

skills.0.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the target's total Bleed and Rupture is 5+, Clash Power +1

skills.0.effects.1.text: [On Use] If total Bleed and Rupture Count is 7+, gain 5 Poise and 2 Poise Count

skills.0.response.text: Bleed and Rupture increase Power and Poise. Avoid accumulating statuses on Hong Lu; redirect the clash to another Sinner.

skills.1.effects.0.text: [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 5 total Bleed and Rupture on the target (max 3)

skills.1.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Defense Level Down next turn.

skills.1.response.text: In addition to the base maximum of 13, Bleed and Rupture can add up to 3 Coin Power. Avoid forcing a low-SP ally to take it; win with a strong regular skill or E.G.O.

skills.2.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the main target's total Bleed and Rupture is 10+, Attack Weight +1

skills.2.effects.3.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 3 Poison

skills.2.response.text: The second Coin is Unbreakable. At 10+ total Bleed and Rupture on the main target, Attack Weight becomes 3. Check remaining hits, Poison, and secondary area targets even after winning.

skills.3.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the target's total Bleed and Rupture is 10+, Coin Power +1

skills.3.effects.1.text: On each Critical Hit, inflict Bleed and 1 Defense Level Down

skills.3.effects.3.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Rupture Count +2

skills.3.effects.6.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 2 Rupture

skills.3.effects.9.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 2 Rupture

skills.3.response.text: All 3 Coins are Unbreakable. Winning prevents some Rupture, but the enemy's on-hit SP recovery remains. Avoid concentrating hits on Hong Lu; use resistance and healing.

skills.4.effects.0.text: [On Use] Coin Power +1 for each negative status type on the main target (max 2)

skills.4.effects.1.text: [On Clash Lose] Deal 50% less damage; this skill's damage cannot Stagger targets

skills.4.effects.2.text: [After Attack] Gain 2 Bind and 6 Defense Level Down next turn

skills.4.effects.5.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 3 Bleed

skills.4.effects.7.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 3 Poison

skills.4.response.text: 4 Attack Weight and 3 Unbreakable Coins. Winning halves damage and prevents Stagger from this skill. On-use bonuses remain; avoid main targets with many debuffs.

skills.5.effects.1.text: [On Use] If the target's total Bleed and Rupture is 5+, Coin Power +2

skills.5.effects.3.text: [On Use] Gain 3 Poise and 2 Poise Count

skills.5.response.text: Clashable Guard cannot be Offset by defense skills. Winning also does not undo its on-use SP recovery. Only consider not attacking it after securing necessary clashes against other attacks.

skills.6.effects.2.text: If the target is Hong Lu, damage is fixed at 0

skills.6.effects.3.text: [After Attack] If the target is Hong Lu, Stagger him and turn him into Precious Jade's Cradle next turn. Then end the turn

skills.6.response.text: Unredirectable and targets Hong Lu. Early on, winning does not stop post-attack imprisonment. With Happiness, Hong Lu can win to prevent it; his Lord Identity's exclusive support can prevent it earlier. Ends the turn after attacking.

skills.7.name.text: Supernatural, Strength, Chaos, and Spirits - Yin Si You [寅巳酉]

skills.7.effects.0.text: [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 5 total Bleed and Rupture on the target (max 2)

skills.7.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed and 2 Rupture

skills.7.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed and 2 Rupture

skills.7.response.text: Coin Power increases for every 5 total Bleed and Rupture. Stop it with regular skills while retaining strong skills for area attacks.

skills.8.name.text: You do not know the fathoms of the eye's powers, its special nature

skills.8.effects.1.text: [On Use] If a Precious Jade is present, all Coins of this skill become Unbreakable

skills.8.effects.2.text: [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 5 total Bleed and Rupture on the target (max 2)

skills.8.effects.3.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Bleed Count +3 and Rupture Count +3

skills.8.effects.4.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Bleed and 1 Rupture

skills.8.effects.5.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Bleed and 1 Rupture

skills.8.response.text: All Coins become Unbreakable while the Jade is alive, or when Last-ditch Struggle is active and Hong Lu is main target. Even after defeating the Jade, redirect away from Hong Lu and check the conditions each time.

skills.9.effects.1.text: [On Clash Win] Gain 5 Poise and 2 Poise Count

skills.9.effects.2.text: [On Clash Lose] Gain 2 Offense Level Up and 2 Defense Level Down next turn

skills.9.effects.3.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bind and 2 Fragile next turn

skills.9.effects.4.text: [On Hit] Bleed Count +2 and Rupture Count +2

skills.9.response.text: An enemy clash win grants Poise; even your win grants the enemy Offense Level Up next turn. Evade is an option when unable to clash, but do not assume a one-sided attack on Hong Lu is safe.

skills.10.name.text: You do not know the fate of a Hierarch without the Xianren's care!

skills.10.effects.1.text: [On Clash Lose] Deal 50% less damage; targets cannot be Staggered by this skill's damage

skills.10.effects.3.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Deal +2.5% damage for every 1 total Rupture and Bleed on the target (max 50%)

skills.10.effects.6.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Deal +2.5% damage for every 1 total Rupture and Bleed on the target (max 50%)

skills.10.effects.7.text: [On Hit] Inflict 3 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2

skills.10.effects.9.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Deal +2.5% damage for every 1 total Rupture and Bleed on the target (max 50%)

skills.10.effects.10.text: [On Hit] Inflict 3 Rupture and increase Rupture Count by 2

skills.10.response.text: 7 Attack Weight and 3 Unbreakable Coins. Winning halves damage and prevents Stagger from this skill. The on-use 25 SP recovery and on-hit Poison, Bleed, and Rupture remain; heal beforehand.

skills.11.effects.1.text: [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 5 total Bleed and Rupture on the target (max 3)

skills.11.effects.2.text: [On Clash Win] Rupture Count +1; inflict 2 Defense Level Down

skills.11.response.text: The Torso's Clashable Guard. 1 Coin is Unbreakable. Defense skills cannot Offset it, and on-use Power bonuses remain.

skills.12.effects.2.text: [On Use] If the main target is below 50% HP or has 10+ total Rupture and Bleed, Coins become Unbreakable

skills.12.effects.4.text: - Gain 2 instead if the clash was lost to Hong Lu

skills.12.effects.5.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 4 Bleed and 4 Rupture next turn

skills.12.effects.7.text: [On Hit] Deal 10 SP damage and raise the Stagger Threshold by 50% of damage dealt

skills.12.response.text: Becomes Unbreakable if the main target is below 50% HP or has 10+ total Bleed and Rupture. Choose a healed handler or Evade, and check the next area attack after Last-ditch Struggle is gained.

skills.13.name.text: A Hierarch without the Xianren's blessing is a Hierarch in name only; she will die an insect's death!!!

skills.13.effects.0.text: [On Use] At 30% body HP or lower, Coin Power +3 and damage +30%

skills.13.effects.1.text: [On Use] Below 50% body HP, this skill's Coins become Unbreakable

skills.13.effects.2.text: [On Clash Lose] Deal 50% less damage; targets cannot be Staggered by this skill's damage

skills.13.effects.3.text: Ⅰ[On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 1 Heaping Obedience

skills.13.effects.7.text: Ⅱ[On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 2 Heaping Obedience

skills.13.response.text: Unbreakable below 50% body HP; gains +3 Coin Power at 30% or lower. Win to halve damage and prevent Stagger from this skill, then use healing and resistance against remaining Bleed/Rupture.

skills.14.name.text: Be honored to be in audience of such a great man

skills.14.effects.0.text: Can be clashed regardless of Speed; cannot be Staggered until this skill is used

skills.14.effects.1.text: [On Use] Grant the Torso part 2 Attack Power Up, 2 Defense Power Up, and 2 Damage Up next turn

skills.14.effects.3.text: [On Clash Lose] Deal 50% less damage; this skill's damage cannot Stagger targets

skills.14.effects.5.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 10 Sinking

skills.14.response.text: The Palanquin's Unbreakable attack with 7 Attack Weight. Can be clashed regardless of Speed. Winning halves damage but does not stop on-use Torso buffs for next turn. Prioritize destroying the Palanquin itself.

skills.15.name.text: Be with this little girl, O Xianren

skills.15.effects.0.text: [Combat Start] Grant the Torso part and body Shield equal to 10% of their respective maximum HP

skills.15.effects.1.text: [On Use] Grant the Torso part 1 Attack Power Up, 1 Defense Power Up, and 2 Damage Up next turn

skills.15.effects.4.text: [On Hit] Inflict 3 Sinking and increase Sinking Count by 2

skills.15.response.text: At Combat Start, the Palanquin gives the body and Torso Shield equal to 10% of their respective maximum HP. Clash wins alone cannot stop it; focus damage on the Palanquin and extract it.

skills.16.effects.0.text: Can be clashed regardless of Speed; cannot be Staggered before using this skill

skills.16.effects.1.text: [Combat Start] Create 5 elder trees next turn

skills.16.effects.2.text: [On Clash Lose] Deal 50% less damage; targets cannot be Staggered by this skill

skills.16.response.text: 7 Attack Weight and Unbreakable Coins. At Combat Start, schedules 5 elders for next turn; winning does not cancel the summon. Ends the turn after attacking, so heal beforehand.

skills.17.name.text: Please give me, Shi Miyin, your strength!

skills.17.effects.0.text: If the target has 50%+ HP, Coin Power +1

skills.17.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Heal the lowest-HP ally without Imperfect Immortality for 15% of that ally's maximum HP

skills.17.effects.3.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Heal the lowest-HP ally without Imperfect Immortality for 15% of that ally's maximum HP

skills.17.response.text: On hit, heals a low-HP enemy ally without Imperfect Immortality. Reduce elders to 1 HP to convert them, rather than leaving them partly damaged.

skills.18.name.text: An Offering of Extreme Extracted Immortality [極仙榨滴供養]

skills.18.effects.1.text: This skill does not deal damage to allies

skills.18.effects.2.text: [On Use] Coin Power +2 and damage +20% for each ally with Sublime Immortality

skills.18.effects.3.text: [On Use] If no allies have Sublime Immortality, instead grant all targets 200 Shield

skills.18.effects.6.text: [On Hit] If the target is an ally, absorb its remaining HP and Imperfect Immortality; all parts gain the absorbed amount of that status next turn. Then remove the absorbed target

skills.18.response.text: 13 Attack Weight and Unbreakable Coins. Converting all 5 elders to Imperfect Immortality grants 200 Shield and enables Stagger after absorption. Any remaining Sublime Immortality strengthens it. Ends the turn after attacking.

skills.19.effects.1.text: [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 5 total Bleed and Rupture on the target (max 3)

skills.19.effects.2.text: [On Clash Win] Rupture Count +1; inflict 2 Defense Level Down

skills.19.response.text: The Palanquin's Clashable Guard. Unlike the Torso's same-named skill, its listing has no Unbreakable Coins. Check the part when reading predictions.

skills.20.effects.1.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Deal 5 SP damage to the target

skills.20.effects.2.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 1 Fragile next turn

skills.20.response.text: An Unbreakable single-target skill. Winning prevents the SP damage and Fragile requiring a hit without Coin destruction, but destroying the Jade remains the priority.

skills.21.effects.1.text: [On Clash Win] Heal Jia Mu for 15 SP; heal 30 instead if her SP is below 0

skills.21.response.text: A Clashable Guard. An enemy win greatly restores Mu's SP. Win with Lust/Gluttony damage and reduce HP through the Guard too.

skills.22.effects.1.text: [After Attack] This character dies and restores Jia Mu's SP to 45. Grant Jia Mu 2 Attack Power Up and 5 Damage Up next turn

mechanics.0.effect.text: Base Offense Level and base Defense Level +2.

mechanics.0.response.text: The initial form's table is before buffs. Check level-difference clash bonuses in the prediction.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Base Offense Level and base Defense Level +4.

mechanics.1.response.text: A post-Distortion buff, separate from the part table and skill-level differences.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Clash Power -2 against Mu. Removed at 45 SP or a value of 0; decreases by 1 at Turn End.

mechanics.2.response.text: Avoid building this on Hong Lu early and bring SP recovery.

mechanics.3.effect.text: At 3 at Turn End, becomes Hollow Obedience next turn.

mechanics.3.response.text: Prevent one-sided hits on Hong Lu and dangerous skills' effects requiring hits without Coin destruction.

mechanics.4.effect.text: The imprisoned Sinner cannot act, and their HP, SP, and buffs do not update. A corresponding Precious Jade is created.

mechanics.4.response.text: Have Sinners destroy the Jade to gain its support and a next-turn return. After Happiness is gained, Hong Lu's clash wins can prevent imprisonment.

mechanics.5.effect.text: Created at 1. At Turn End, heal the imprisoned Sinner for 25% HP, reduce their SP by 20, and increase this value. At 3, use the self-destruct skill; dying by self-destruction inflicts 3 Hollow Obedience on the imprisoned Sinner next turn.

mechanics.5.response.text: Destroy it before it explodes. Waiting for self-destruction does not grant the rewards for a Sinner defeating it.

mechanics.6.effect.text: If Hong Lu is main target of the eye's powers attack, make all Coins Unbreakable independently of that skill's own condition.

mechanics.6.response.text: Check especially after Still, you can do nothing is used. Destroying the Jade alone does not remove this condition.

mechanics.7.effect.text: Hong Lu gains +1 Clash Power. While another ally lives, lethal damage restores 50% HP. Prevents imprisonment once in the phase; +5 Clash Power against the imprisonment skill. Winning prevents imprisonment and clears Stagger; Mu loses 10 SP and gains 2 Fragile. Clash wins against Mu grant a total of 3 scarce E.G.O resources.

mechanics.7.response.text: Support gained from phase 3. It does not guarantee opening survival; have Hong Lu handle Precious Jade's Cradle [寶玉搖籃].

mechanics.8.effect.text: Hong Lu gains +1 Final Power. On Clash Win, heal the lowest-SP ally for 5 SP. The 50% HP recovery while another ally lives and 3 resources from wins against Mu continue.

mechanics.8.response.text: From Joy, the buff increases Final Power. Continue healing and resource generation while handling the Palanquin.

mechanics.9.effect.text: Hong Lu gains +3 Final Power. Continues allied SP recovery on wins, 50% HP recovery while another ally lives, and 3 resources. When an ally dies, grant remaining allies 1 Attack Power Up next turn at Turn End (once per turn).

mechanics.9.response.text: Combine this with resources from elders and keep the other allies alive.

mechanics.10.effect.text: Hong Lu gains +5 Final Power. At Turn Start, heal all allies for 5 SP. Retains 50% HP recovery while another ally lives, 3 resources, and the buff on ally death. Damage increases by 30% of the cumulative percentage of HP lost (max 100%).

mechanics.10.response.text: Supports final clashes and damage, but the survival condition fails if every other ally dies.

mechanics.11.effect.text: Held by elders. At Turn Start, give Mu's body and all parts Shield equal to 5% of their respective maximum HP.

mechanics.11.response.text: Reduce them to 1 HP to convert to Imperfect Immortality. Handle all 5 before the Offering.

mechanics.12.effect.text: Gained when elders reach 1 HP. Absorbed by a specific Mu skill; on Mu, each stack gives 1 Fragile, and 5 stacks cause Stagger.

mechanics.12.response.text: Do not try to kill 1-HP elders; switch to those still holding Sublime Immortality.

warnings.0.text: Hong Lu's lethal-damage recovery starts only after Happiness is gained and requires at least 1 other living ally. It cannot be relied on during the opening or while he is the sole survivor.

warnings.1.text: Precious Jade's Cradle [寶玉搖籃] ends the turn after attacking. Winning alone prevents imprisonment only when the support conditions are met.

warnings.2.text: For the eye's powers attack, separately check the Jade's presence and the Last-ditch Struggle / Hong Lu main-target condition.

warnings.3.text: The Jade's self-destruction does not grant defeat rewards. Prioritize destroying it with Sinners.

warnings.4.text: Winning clashes alone does not stop Shield from the Palanquin and elders. Handle the sources themselves.

warnings.5.text: Listed phase-transition HP values differ. Avoid plans requiring exact numbers; check the enemy's form, actions, and Hong Lu's support.

warnings.6.text: The Offering and similar skills end the turn after attacking. Heal beforehand rather than scheduling healing afterward.

preparation.0.text: Recommended Level 55. Deploy 7 Sinners including Hong Lu, with 5 reserves. Bring HP/SP recovery E.G.O and skill affinities that supply their resources.

preparation.1.text: Combine Speed, Bind, Lust/Gluttony single-target damage, and area attacks for elders. No specific Identity or old bug is required.

roles.0.reason.text: Protect Hong Lu before Happiness is gained and redirect the eye's powers attack away from him as main target.

roles.1.name.text: Focused damage for the Jade and Palanquin

roles.1.reason.text: Cut off Shield sources early to create time to damage the body.

roles.2.reason.text: Use rewards from Hong Lu's wins, the Jade, and elders to recover from long-fight attrition.

roles.3.reason.text: Reduce all 5 to 1 HP, checking the body's slot weight and actual secondary targets.
